reasoning: This is a standard word-processor toolbar glyph for Right-to-Left (RTL) paragraph text direction (a pilcrow above a leftward arrow). Because it is an interface formatting toggle rather than a concrete object or common life activity, it only fits rare software localization or typography tasks and should be discarded as a general to-do icon.
